title: FM Lab
description: A 4-operator FM synthesizer — route algorithms, sculpt timbre, play it live, and print your take to a real WAV.
concept: A pocket DX7: four sine operators you patch into one of four classic FM algorithms (chain, twin stack, bell cluster, organ fan), each with its own pitch ratio and level/index. A shared ADSR shapes every note, five factory presets and a save-slot library get you started fast, and a two-octave on-screen + QWERTY keyboard lets you actually perform on it.
features: 4 selectable FM routing algorithms with a live SVG signal-flow diagram
Per-operator ratio + level (modulation index) controls with real-time role labels
5 factory presets (Bell, E.Piano, Bass, Brass, Pluck) plus save/load custom patch slots
Live oscilloscope visualizer driven by an AnalyserNode
Two-octave playable keyboard (mouse, touch, and QWERTY) with polyphony
One-click performance recording exported as a real 16-bit PCM WAV download
Shareable patch links via URL hash + persistent localStorage autosave

interaction.mouse: Click and hold piano keys to play notes; drag sliders to shape operators, envelope, and volume
interaction.click: Click algorithm cards, presets, and save/share buttons
interaction.touch: Tap and hold keyboard keys to play; all controls are touch-sized
interaction.keyboard: A W S E D F T G Y H U J K O L P ; play notes across two octaves
